security_privacy_cost_impact: Tightens only, and only against later drift: nothing reachable on the clean set changes. A later file that makes a client a member of any role, grants a client USAGE or CREATE on a schema beyond the four pinned triples, grants a client anything on a view or table in any new schema, adds a SECURITY DEFINER function to an extension, spells a SET through U& or E'' escapes, widens notifications_update_own_read_state together with its pin, or puts OR, TRUE or NOT into a pinned narrowing now fails a layer by name. No data, secret or cost impact. The review round tightens further, again only against later drift: an object a later file puts in information_schema, pg_catalog, pg_toast or a pg_* schema, any mention of allow_system_table_mods in a fed script, and CREATE on the database for a client now fail migrate-clean (or static) by name.
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. Batch 128, review round included, adds no migration and needs no migration number; it changes catalog probes, the psql lexer, static tests, the README and one rls-smoke case. No database state changes.
compatibility_impact: Additive. Cases 1078 -> 1079 (owner-a-cannot-mark-a-teammates-notification-read-by-a-bare-update); tests stay 677; foundation-contract's assertion floor 480 -> 494 (no test added or renamed); probes 21 -> 23. A later batch that grants a client a schema privilege, a role membership, or makes an extension member SECURITY DEFINER pins it in CLIENT_SCHEMA_PRIVILEGES, CLIENT_ROLE_MEMBERSHIPS or EXTENSION_DEFINER_FUNCTIONS with its reason; a fed file may not use U& or E'' string or identifier spellings.
known_limitations: C0 F2 (C0 N3 on 127's re-check): a looser permissive SELECT sibling on a client-readable, non-writable table is held by rls-smoke alone; the permissive policy probe reads client-writable tables only.

A client-encoding change whose name or SET words are computed at run time (concatenation, chr(), format(), convert_from(); EXECUTE of a SET built in a DO body) is outside psqlLex's list; the static spellings (U&, E'') are refused since batch 128. Owed.
A function reached through an operator is not read by the policy helper probe's called-function rule (Q0 N5, INFO); the deparse pins hold it on client-writable tables.

The other roles' reach (app_worker, service_role, RFC-2026-023 command roles) is read by no rule here, for RFC-2026-023's disposition; with it blocker 186's (15) command-role half, (16) (the anonymisation route batch 160 needs) and (20) stay owed.

A constant-true narrowing spelled without OR, TRUE or NOT (1 = 1) is not read statically; the three owner-UPDATE permissive policies (workspaces, workspace_settings, workspace_invitations) have no bare-UPDATE case of their own.
The client schema and membership probes model the CI shim; on the platform the managed schemas grant clients USAGE and authenticator is a member of the client roles, and the probes do not run there.
Remedy (b), created_by out of the client INSERT grant, is not taken, by the Owner's answer of 2026-10-03. 122's service-path closures are pinned by exact deparse in no probe.

C0 F3 (INFO): the client roles' own attributes (rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolinherit) are read by no catalog rule; `alter role authenticated bypassrls` is held by rls-smoke alone (347 of 1079). Owed.
A1 N1 (INFO): pg_default_acl is not read; a default privilege granted to a client is named only by its effect on a later object. Owed.

allow_system_table_mods set by a name computed at run time passes the lexer by design; what it enables is read by OID (X2c, X2bc). The pg_catalog guard reads relations, functions, operators and casts, not other object kinds, in an initdb schema.
